dct_creator_sm: Prince Edward Field Naturalists/South Shore Joint Initiative.
dct_description_sm: Summer survey of the main stem of the Black River from its mouth to south of the Mill Pond. Survey included riparian vegetation, transect cross sections of vegetation, mapping, site features.  Point features of pollutants and then a single day survey of water quality.  Times of each measurement were not recorded.
dct_title_s: Black Creek (Prince Edward County) Watershed Study
